title: Nanoindentation Experiment: PMDCo (Simplified Input)
description: User-friendly form for a nanoindentation experiment session. Enter test conditions as individual fields and summary statistics as a results array. The transform converts this to full OO-LD (MeasurementDatum + ScalarValueSpecification nodes).

experiment_name.title: Experiment Name
experiment_name.description: Human-readable name for this measurement session.

experiment_id.title: Experiment ID
experiment_id.description: Optional IRI slug for the RDF node. Auto-derived from experiment_name if omitted.

specimen_iri.title: Specimen IRI (pre-test)
specimen_iri.description: IRI of the pre-test specimen KItem — input to this experiment (obi:has_specified_input).

specimen_post_iri.title: Post-test Specimen IRI
specimen_post_iri.description: IRI of the post-test specimen KItem — output of this experiment (obi:has_specified_output).

dataset_iris.title: Dataset IRIs
dataset_iris.description: IRIs of dataset KItems produced by this experiment (obi:has_specified_output).

test_date.title: Test Date
test_date.description: Date the measurement session was conducted (ISO 8601).

instrument_serial.title: Instrument Serial Number
instrument_serial.description: Serial number of the nanoindenter used.

control_mode.title: Control Mode
control_mode.description: Feedback control mode used during loading.

analysis_method.title: Analysis Method
analysis_method.description: Method used to extract hardness and modulus from the load-displacement curve.

max_depth.title: Max Depth (µm)
max_depth.description: Target maximum indentation depth in micrometres.

max_load.title: Max Load (mN)
max_load.description: Target maximum applied force in millinewtons (load-controlled only).

loading_rate.title: Loading Rate (1/s)
loading_rate.description: Strain rate or loading rate in per second.

hold_time.title: Hold Time (s)
hold_time.description: Dwell time at maximum load/depth in seconds.

poisson_ratio.title: Assumed Poisson's Ratio
poisson_ratio.description: Poisson's ratio assumed for elastic modulus calculation (dimensionless).

unload_fit_range.title: Unload Fit Range
unload_fit_range.description: Percentage range of the unloading curve used for Oliver-Pharr fit, e.g. '40%-98%'.

tip_area_function.title: Tip Area Function Reference
tip_area_function.description: Description of the tip area function used, e.g. 'Factory calibration — Berkovich'.

test_temperature.title: Test Temperature (°C)
test_temperature.description: Ambient temperature during testing in degrees Celsius.

test_humidity.title: Relative Humidity (%)
test_humidity.description: Ambient relative humidity during testing in percent.

summary_results.title: Summary Statistics
summary_results.description: Aggregate results across all valid indentations. Add one entry per statistic.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: GPa for hardness/modulus, um for depth, - for counts
